about: 2026-11-15 (gameplayfix, item 6): power meters in a Royal Rumble with 10 in the ring at once (qa_rr_ring 10, 20 entrants, one every 10 s; eliminations from 200 s). The user's spec: at most 8 meters (6 now: the places the engine has), each in a place of its own (top left / centre / right, bottom left / centre / right), none for the others in the ring, an eliminated man's meter to the next in the queue (entry order), a player's man always with one. LOOK at the shots: never more than six panels, none on top of another, none in the middle of the screen; after an elimination its place is filled by another man's panel (his name in it)

expect.name: the Rumble started
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30

expect.name: the match has room for 10 (its slot count)
seven or more in the ring at once (meters handed out)
